title: Meniscal Imaging

positions.as_written: Read the meniscus on more than one plane, because a plane cuts the circumferential fibres at a different angle in each part of the joint.
Expect the angle to vary smoothly from front to back rather than at one site.
Compare the two menisci in the same knee, since their curvature differs and the field does not.
Keep the report to what survives that test.
At decision level the question is whether a knee goes to arthroscopy, and meniscal signal without a surface is the commonest reason it should not.
